detaileddescription.para: Forward SIGILL from illegal instructions to catchsegv in ci.yaml. Provides additional debugging information via -rdynamic.
Forward SIGABRT from std::abort and assert to catchsegv in ci.yaml. Provides additional debugging information via -rdynamic.
Stops the execution of the application via the ILLIXR runtime.

inbodydescription.para: When debugging, register the SIGILL and SIGABRT handlers for capturing more info
